text:
Type: triangular wall planter
Use: holding small plants or succulents; mounted on a wall in a living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, minimalist, industrial
Materials: matte earthenware with a concrete look
Colors: cool medium grey
Shape: inverted triangle with a faceted pointed front, flat back for the wall, compact and slim
Feel: graphic, clean, understated
Goes with: white or light walls, succulents, black or wood accents; modern or industrial rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Triangular Wall Mount Planter, 7"H, Modern Earthenware, Grey
product.description: This triangular vase makes a wonderful decorative piece for your wall. It's glazed for a concrete-like appearance, adding a bit of an industrial touch. The neutral tone looks great with or without plants, by itself or in a group of vases. Modern shape with neutral coloring to blend with any style room. 100% earthenware 5.5"W X 2.1"D X 7"H; interior 4.725"W x 1.77"D x 6.1"H Durable piece with hole on back for easy mounting on wall
